description_en: You can this operation to obtain a list of row and column permission configurations for a specified dataset
description_zh: 获取指定数据集的行列权限配置列表
name: ListCubeDataLevelPermissionConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the training dataset that you want to remove from the specified custom linguistic model
parameters.name: cube_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the dataset row and column permission. Valid values:

*   ROW_LEVEL: row-level permissions
*   COLUMN_LEVEL: column-level permissions
parameters.help_zh:
数据集行列权限类型。取值范围：

- ROW_LEVEL：行级权限
- COLUMN_LEVEL：列级权限
parameters.name: rule_type
